(Deep inside Kali, Medea senses a familiar presence and looks toward the entrance. When she spots her visitor, her face lights up with a warm smile.)
You look as though you haven't been sleeping well.
strings.꿈을 꿨는데, 어떤 내용인지는 잘 모르겠어요. 다만, 한 단어가 계속 남: I had a dream, but I can't remember what it was about. Just one word keeps coming back to me.
Since you've come to see me, I imagine that word is 'witch.'
strings.마녀들 중 일부가 %s의 존재를 인식한 것 같습니다. 아무래도 큰일이 지: It seems some of the witches have become aware of you, %s. A great deal has happened, after all.
strings.이리스 님에게도 어떤 영향이 있었을 것 같은데…. 만나 뵙고 이야기를 하: I imagine Lady Iris has felt some effects as well... Perhaps we should speak with her?
What a warm breeze. Welcome, Lady Iris.
strings.(곁으로 칼리의 바람을 타고 온 것 같은 보라색 붓꽃 잎이 떨어진다.): (A purple iris petal drifts down beside you, as though carried on the winds of Kali.)
strings.(땅에 떨어진 꽃잎이 사라진 그 자리에 이리스의 모습이 마치 한 송이 꽃: (The petal vanishes as it touches the ground, and Iris blooms into being in its place.)
(Iris beams when %s waves to her, then takes both their hands.)
It's good to see you both.
strings.원래는 두 분을 제가 있는 곳으로 모시려고 했지만 그러지 못했어요. 두: I had meant to invite you to where I'm staying, but I couldn't. It might be dangerous for you there.
I sensed an attempt to connect the Demon Realm to this world through some sort of passage.
strings.이스트랜드에 있었던 흔적이 사라져서 다행이라 여겼지만, 오히려 크고 작은: I was relieved when its traces vanished from Eastland. But now powers great and small are reaching out in all sorts of ways.
strings.아마도 그건 마계의 각 영역을 지키는 일명 군주급의 존재들일 거예요. 그: They are probably the beings known as lords, who rule the various territories of the Demon Realm. Lux would be among them...
And I sensed another power from within this world, trying to connect this planet to the Demon Realm...
Your dream may not have been a dream at all, %s. It might have been an unspoken warning.
strings.방해하지 말라는…?: To stay out of their way...?
We have to find the witches.
strings.그런 목적을 가진 마녀들이 누군지, 어디에 있는지, 어떤 모습으로 있는지: I don't know which witches are behind this, where they are, or what forms they have taken. So...
It's all right, Lady Iris... I will help. Please don't worry too much.
strings.그러면 마녀들을 찾는 일이 먼저겠네…. 찾아야 뭐라도 할 수 있을 테니까: Then finding them comes first... We can't do anything until we know where they are.
strings.지금은 저도, %s도 알고 있는 것이 많이 없지만, 그래도 무리하진 마세: Neither of us knows very much yet, %s, but please don't push yourself too hard.
I should go. I only had a moment to spare, so I need to return right away.
Until we meet again, Lady Iris...
strings.(다시 한번 따뜻한 꽃향기를 실은 바람이 불어오면서 이리스의 모습이 사라: (Another breeze carries the warm scent of flowers past you, and Iris disappears.)
Oh, of course. Noel sent me some lovely tea leaves. I should have offered her a cup. Too late for Lady Iris now... %s, there is something I'd like to discuss. Could you wait a moment?
Of course. What did you want to talk about...?
strings.(잠시 후, 메디아가 새로운 차를 준비해 %s 앞에 내놓는다.): (A little later, Medea sets a freshly prepared cup of tea before %s.)
Noel took great care in choosing it, so I would expect nothing less. Hehe...
strings.%s…. 조금 애매하긴 하지만, 마녀를 찾을 수 있는 방법이 떠올랐습니다: %s... It is only a vague idea, but I may have thought of a way to find a witch.
strings.어릴 적 저는 그 사람과 숨바꼭질을 하면서 놀았던 기억이 있습니다. 저는: When I was little, I remember playing hide-and-seek with that person. I could never find them...
strings.그 사람은 언제나 저를 찾아냈죠. 어떻게 찾아냈냐고 물어도 대답해주지: But they always found me. Whenever I asked how, they would never tell me.
I remember they were always carrying something when they found me.
strings.네, 정확히 기억은 나질 않지만, 깃털이 하나 달려 있었습니다. 하얗고: Yes. I cannot remember it clearly, but there was a feather attached to it. That white, sacred feather always pointed toward me.
There must have been more to it than that, but I think it is a place to start.
Michaela's an angel. She should know, right? I'll head to the sanctuary and ask her.
In the meantime, I will try to remember more. There may have been something else...
strings.메디아 님, 괜찮겠어요?: Will you be all right, Medea?
I will. Please do not worry... I am no longer the person I once was.
Go on. I will be waiting for you.
I'll be back as soon as I can.
strings.(메디아가 환한 미소를 지으며 배웅한다.): (Medea sees you off with a bright smile.)
Medea's smile seems more at ease than before. Well, off to Hyle.
strings.(여전히 붉은 빛으로 가득한 힐레, 안으로 들어가자마자 천사 미카엘라가: (Hyle is still awash in red. As soon as you enter, the angel Michaela approaches, spreading white wings untouched by the crimson light.)
strings.(미카엘라가 가까이 다가와 가볍게 볼 키스를 한다.): (Michaela comes closer and lightly kisses your cheek.)
W-whoa! Oh, right, your greeting. S-sorry. I'm still not used to it...
strings.(당황하는 %s의 표정을 보고 있던 미카엘라가 살며시 미소를 짓는다.): (Michaela watches %s's flustered expression and smiles softly.)
Thank you for driving away the evil presence in that faraway place.
strings.미카는 잘 지냈어. 오늘은 무슨 일이야…? 혹시 바보토스가 나타났어?: Mika's been well. What brings you here today...? Has that fool Barbatos shown up?
strings.바보토스, 아니 바르바토스 일은 아니에요. 도움을 청하고 싶은 게 있어서: That fool—no, this isn't about Barbatos. There's something I'd like your help with...
strings.(미카엘라에게 메디아의 이야기를 짧게 전한다.): (You briefly explain Medea's story to Michaela.)
An angel's feather is a blessing. That is why other beings believe it can grant wishes.
strings.아마 그 아이를 찾았던 물건에 달려있던 건…. 그 아이를 찾기 위한 힘이: The feather on the object that found her... It probably held the power to seek her out.
And it wasn't from Mika's wings. Mika isn't the only angel, you know.
strings.(다른 천사를 만날 수도 있다는 건가? 흐음….): (Does that mean I might meet another angel someday? Hmm...)
strings.미카는 천사야. 미카의 깃털에 그 아이의 힘을 담으면 원하는 도구의 소재: Mika is an angel. If you imbue Mika's feather with that girl's power, it can become a material for the tool you need.
Mika will give you a wing feather. But first, we'll spar.
Mika will be waiting at the far end. See you there.
strings.(미카엘라가 할 말을 끝내고 등 뒤에 접혀있던 날개를 펼친다. 전투를 고: (With that, Michaela unfolds the wings tucked behind her back. Eager for a fight, the angel beats her white wings and flies off into Hyle.)
Another sparring match with Michaela... I'll just think of it as part of the process.
strings.(미카엘라가 힘찬 날갯짓을 하자 다가갈 수 없을 정도로 강한 바람이 일어: (Michaela beats her wings powerfully, whipping up winds so fierce you cannot approach.)
Our sparring match is over. Wait a moment, %s.
(Michaela nods and picks up a feather that has fallen to the ground. A moment later, white light spills from its tip and envelops her hand.
strings.(시간이 멈춘 것 같은 붉은 세계, 그 안에서 펼쳐지는 빛은 보는 것만으: (In this crimson world where time seems to stand still, the sight of that light fills you with a sense of the divine.)
strings.미카의 깃털을 그 아이에게 전해줘. 여신님을 돕는다면 아낌없이 미카의 힘: Give Mika's feather to that girl. If it will help the goddess, Mika will share her power freely.
I hope it helps. Mika is happy too.
If you're grateful, bring Mika some cookies next time.
strings.쿠키요? 그럴게요. 디저트 잘하는 곳이 있어서 다음에 올 때 가지고 올게: Cookies? Of course. I know a place that makes great desserts. I'll bring some next time.
The Glaston cookies Argent gave Mika as a thank-you were delicious too.
strings.아우룸이 쿠키 준다고 해서 갔는데, 미카 아르젠트 만났어. 여동생 선물을: Aurum said she had cookies for Mika, so Mika went to see her and met Argent. He was trying to find a present for his little sister, so Mika gave him one.
strings.설마 쿠키를 받아서 선물로 깃털을 주신 건가요?: Don't tell me you gave him a feather in exchange for cookies?
strings.(미카엘라가 악의라고는 하나도 없는 표정으로 대답한다.): (Michaela answers with an utterly innocent expression.)
strings.그래도 용도가 달라. 지금 미카가 주는 깃털은 생일 선물 깃털보다 더 특: But they have different purposes. The feather Mika is giving you now is more special than a birthday-present feather.
Because it's to help the goddess.
That's right, Michaela. This feather will help everyone.
strings.(미카엘라가 어디선가 쿠키 모양이 그려진 상자 두 개를 가지고 온다. 한: (Michaela returns with two boxes decorated with pictures of cookies. She places one in %s’s hands and takes two cookies from the other.)
strings.(그리고 쿠키 하나를 자신의 입에, 다른 하나는 %s의 입 앞으로 들이민: (She puts one cookie in her own mouth and holds the other up to %s's.)
strings.%s. 이거 맛있어. 가면서 먹어. 이건 그 아이 주고. 미카 하나 또: %s, these are delicious. Have some on your way. Give this box to that girl. Mika has another one. (Munch, munch.)
Thank you for the cookies, Michaela. I'll be going, then.
strings.응. 다음에도 도움이 필요하면 미카에게 이야기해. (우물우물): Okay. If you need help again, tell Mika. (Munch, munch.)
strings.(미카엘라가 다른 맛 쿠키 하나를 입에 물고는 붉은 달이 있는 하늘 위로: (Michaela pops a different cookie into her mouth, then soars into the sky toward the red moon.)
strings.붉은 달과 하얀 날개의 천사라…, 뭔가 묘하게 어울리네. 그나저나 이번엔: A red moon and an angel with white wings... They suit each other in a strange way. I have a feeling this is going to be quite a long journey...
strings.아, 내가 무슨 말을 한 거지? 에이, 설마 별일이야 있겠어. 쓸데 없는: Wait, why did I say that? Oh, come on. Surely nothing's going to happen. Enough worrying. Let's go.
strings.오, 이 쿠키 맛있네. (우물우물): Oh, these cookies are good. (Munch, munch.)
Michaela gave me a feather infused with her sacred power.
(You give Medea the angel's sacred feather and pass on Michaela's message. Light pours from the feather, circles Medea, and fades away.)
Such a precious gift... How can I ever repay her kindness?
strings.어, 그런데 손에 들고 계신 건 뭔가요?: Oh, what is that you're holding?
Cookies. Michaela sent them as a gift for you.
strings.깃털 뿐만 아니라 이것도 주시다니…. 나중에 마을 사람들을 불러 함께 먹: She gave me these as well as the feather...? I will invite the villagers to share them later.
strings.(메디아가 놀란 표정으로 쿠키 상자를 바라본다.): (Medea stares at the cookie box in surprise.)
To think this would bring back the memory...
Long ago, that person told me about a certain place while giving me a snack.
strings.별들이 가루처럼 흩어져 숲과 바위와 절벽이 온통 반짝반짝 빛나는 곳이 있: A place where stars scatter like dust, making the forests, rocks, and cliffs shimmer with light.
I've met a witch near there before...
strings.%s에게 꿈처럼 암시를 남겼다면, 그곳에도 뭔가 흔적을 남겨뒀을 것입니다: If they left you a hint in the form of a dream, %s, they must have left some trace there as well.
Tell me what the place is called.
strings.(메디아가 들고 있던 지팡이로 %s의 어깨를 살며시 두드린다.): (Medea gently taps %s's shoulder with her staff.)
strings.바로 마녀를 찾을 수 있는 건 아니겠지만, 그래도 그 마녀들이 조금이라도: This will not let you find the witches right away, but it should bring them before you a little sooner, %s.
strings.제가 가진 마녀의 기운을 살짝 드렸습니다. 나쁜 영향은 없으니 걱정하지: I have given you a little of my own witch aura. It will do you no harm, so there is no need to worry. Though it may make things a little troublesome...
strings.부디 도움이 되시길…. 이제 그들이 말한 '밤'의 장소는 프레이오스겠군요: I hope it helps... So the place of 'night' they spoke of must be Freios. And things will begin somewhere near Stardust Plains...
strings.피곤해 보여요. %s의 숙소는 언제나 마련되어 있으니 충분히 휴식을 취한: You look tired. There is always a room here for you, %s. Get some proper rest before you leave.
strings.바로 데이나 씨에게 갈까 했어요. 아무래도 데이나 씨 자매에게 일어났던: I was going to see Dayna right away. After everything that happened to her and her sisters...
The goddess would worry. Rest a little.
Well, if you put it like that, I can't very well refuse.
strings.(그제야 원하는 답을 얻은 메디아가 가볍게 미소를 짓는다.): (At last getting the answer she wanted, Medea smiles faintly.)
I will ask the villagers to prepare a meal. Please wait a moment.
Medea looks so much more at ease now. She really has changed...
strings.(제대로 준비해서 가봐야겠어. 초인들을 찾아 설득하는 것과는 전혀 다른: (I'd better be properly prepared. This will be nothing like finding and persuading the Champions.)
strings.(데이나가 한숨을 내쉬며 들고 있던 편지를 접어 품에 넣는다. 그러다 다: (Dayna sighs, folds the letter in her hands, and tucks it away. Then she notices %s approaching.)
I was wondering when you'd come. So today's the day.
I had a vague feeling. It seemed like witch business.
strings.최근에 일이 하나 있긴 해. 안 그래도 황성의 요청으로 단원 하나가 나가: Something did come up recently. At the imperial palace's request, one of our members is already out investigating.
Though it was more of an order than a request for help.
strings.%s, 네레이스 관문이라고 알아?: %s, have you heard of Nereis Gateway?
No, this is the first time.
strings.프레이오스의 서부와 동부를 잇는 주요 거점이야. 대륙의 기준이 돼서 서부: It is a major crossroads connecting western and eastern Freios. You could even call it the dividing point between the two halves of the continent.
strings.대륙을 잇는 길이 여기저기 있긴 하지만, 비교적 안전해서 특별한 경우 아: There are other routes across the continent, but this one is relatively safe. Unless they have a particular reason, most people pass through the gate.
You'd be better off going there and finding out the details for yourself.
strings.여기선 어떻게 가나요?: How do I get there from here?
The road to the gate is in Stardust Plains. I'd like to make the trip easier for you, though...
strings.내가 전에 준 카드를 제이드에게 보여주면서 관문 이야기를 해. 그러면 바: Show Jade the card I gave you before and tell him about the gate. He'll send you straight there.
strings.(아, 별가루 평원 근처가 맞았네….): (So it really is near Stardust Plains...)
If you need anything, speak to our member stationed there.
I'm sorry this is all I can do this time. Things have suddenly gotten busy lately...
strings.아니에요, 괜찮아요. 이렇게 알려주신대로 그렇게 말할게요. 고마워요, 데: No, it's fine. I'll do as you said. Thank you, Dayna. I'll head over right away.
strings.(지금까지 언니가 직접 움직이는 일은 없었는데…. 왜, 갑자기….): (My sister has never acted in person before... Why now, all of a sudden...?)
strings.무슨 일로 오셨습니까? 설마 마법학원 일인가요?: What brings you here? Is it about the Magic Academy, by any chance?
strings.네레이스 관문에 갈 일이 있거든요. 데이나 씨 말씀이 제이드에게 가면 더: I need to go to Nereis Gateway. Dayna said you could make the journey easier for me.
That card you're holding... It bears imperial authorization.
strings.바로 네레이스 관문으로 보내드리겠습니다. 잠시만 기다려주시겠습니까?: I will send you to Nereis Gateway at once. Would you wait a moment?
strings.(제이드가 손을 흔들자 같은 로브를 뒤집어쓴 무한회랑의 마법사들이 하나둘: (Jade waves a hand, and mages of the Infinite Corridor begin gathering, one by one, in matching hooded robes.)
strings.(제이드의 지시에 따라 마법사들의 영창이 이어지고, %s의 발밑에서 작고: (At Jade's direction, the mages begin chanting. A small, rather cute magic circle appears beneath %s's feet.)
Everything is ready. Now, %s, please close your eyes.
strings.이 무한회랑 안에 흐르는 공기를 느끼세요. 그리고 상자 안에 있다가 밖으: Feel the air flowing through the Infinite Corridor. Imagine you are a cat in a box, longing to leap outside.
There we are. Now, the space-time magic will...
strings.(순간, 마법진에서 솟아오른 빛이 비명과 함께 모험가를 어딘가로 데려간다: (Suddenly, light surges from the magic circle and whisks the adventurer away with a scream.)
strings.제이드 님, 설명이 좀 길었어요. 그런데 고양이는 뭔가요?: Your explanation was a little long, Jade. What was that about a cat?
strings.얼마 전에 황실 인증 카드를 가지고 온 사람이 하도 그런 소리를 해서 설: Someone who came with an imperial authorization card recently kept talking about that, so I worked it into my explanation.
strings.그건 그렇고 중요한 고양이가 밖으로 안 나와서 큰일이라던데, 지금은 어떻: Speaking of which, they said an important cat wouldn't come out, and it was causing quite a problem. I wonder how that turned out?
strings.게이트를 이루는 마력의 구성이 순간적으로 바뀌었어. 대체 누가 무슨 목적: The magical structure of the gate changed for an instant. Who could have done that, and why...?
strings.(갑자기 소녀의 앞으로 마법진이 하나 펼쳐진다. 마법진 중앙에 커다란 빛: (A magic circle suddenly unfolds before the girl. A pillar of light rises from its center, and someone falls to the ground with a very peculiar cry.)
strings.(소녀가 일어나지 못하고 있는 모험가를 빤히 바라보다가 손가락으로 찔러본: (The girl stares at the adventurer lying on the ground, then pokes them with a finger. When the adventurer flinches, she nods.)
You're alive. Let me help you up.
strings.이 상황에서 부끄럽다고 기절한 척하실 줄은 몰랐어요. 무한회랑의 시공마법: I didn't expect you to pretend to be unconscious out of embarrassment. The Infinite Corridor must have cast that space-time spell awfully quickly.
Thank you. But who are... Oh...
strings.(검은 옷의 소녀가 %s의 표정에서 뭔가 알아차렸는지 고개를 끄덕인다.): (The girl in black seems to read something in %s's expression and nods.)
Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm Licota. Just call me Rico.
Are you with Raclette and Jelic...?
Yes, I'm a colleague of the two people who insist on calling me Ri-ri-rico. Sigh...
The difference is that they work behind the scenes, while I work in the open. I handle official requests from the imperial palace.
strings.이렇게 자세하게 이야기해도 돼요?: Is it all right to tell me this much?
Dayna said you already know about our work, so it would be fine.
I'm here dealing with the strange dolls appearing at Nereis Gateway.
strings.어딘가에 자기 의지로 움직이는 인형들이 있다고 들었지만, 이곳에 나타난: I've heard there are dolls somewhere that move of their own free will, but these are different.
strings.마치 누군가 일부러 뿌려놓은 것 같은…, 누군가 와서 보라고 하는 것처럼: It's as though someone deliberately scattered them here... As though they wanted someone to come and see...
I'm taking care of the dolls, so you needn't worry too much about them.
Work like this is for people like me, with ominous powers...
strings.어쨌든 이곳의 상황을 더 잘 알고 싶으시다면 노토스 님과 에담 님을 찾아: Anyway, if you want to know more about the situation, speak to Notos and Edam. They both work here.
We met during something that happened a while ago.
I see. Oh, there he is over there.
Then I'll go ask him, Licota.
All right, Rico. See you later.
strings.(리코타가 주위를 둘러보다가 문득 기시감을 느낀다. 그러다 자연스레 관문: (As Licota looks around, a sudden sense of deja vu comes over her. Almost without thinking, she approaches the guardrail along the cliff at the gate.)
strings.저 멀리서 이상한 게 느껴져…. 이면 같은 건가? 그건 아닌 것 같은데…: I can feel something strange out there... Some sort of Other Side? No, I don't think so...
strings.(훤칠하게 생긴 청년이 방문객들의 뜨거운 시선을 받으며 아무렇지도 않게: (A handsome young man tries to act naturally under the admiring gazes of the visitors.)
strings.(그게 잘 안되는지 애써 웃으며 지나친다. 그러던 중, 자신에게 다가오는: (Not quite succeeding, he forces a smile and passes them by. Then he recognizes %s approaching and breaks into a bright grin.)
strings.에담? 그때 그 유격병 맞죠?: Edam? You were that ranger, right?
A ranger in Knossos told me your name. Edam...
strings.그래서 제 이름을 알고 계시는군요. 영광입니다. 그동안 잘 지내셨습니까?: So that's how you know my name. I'm honored. Have you been well?
I've been fine. Things get difficult sometimes, though.
I've had a few things happen too, but thanks to you, I've been well.
I'm working here now, providing security, protecting visitors, and handling various other duties.
strings.멀리서나마 활약하시는 소식을 종종 들었습니다. 많은 분을 구하시고 애쓰시: I've often heard of your exploits, even from afar. The effort you put into saving so many people is truly remarkable.
But if you have come here, %s...
Something has come up, and I need to visit another part of Freios.
It must be important... %s, you saved me. I would love to be of help. Just say the word, and I'll do everything I can.
strings.그렇게 말씀하시면 너무 부담스러운데…. 아, 혹시 무슨 일 없죠?: You're making me feel awfully obligated... Oh, has anything unusual been happening here?
strings.몬스터 같은 것들이 종종 나타나긴 하지만, 크게 신경 쓰고 있지는 않습니: Monsters and the like do appear from time to time, but they haven't been a major concern...
strings.잠깐 자리를 옮기시죠. 노토스 님과 함께라면 뭐라도 말씀드릴 수 있을 것: Let's move somewhere else. With Notos here, we may be able to tell you something useful.
strings.(파란색 긴 머리와 붉은 눈동자가 인상적인 청년이 마법서로 보이는 것 같: (A young man with striking long blue hair and red eyes is examining what appears to be a spellbook.)
strings.(뭔가 잘 풀리지 않는지 살짝 굳은 표정이었지만, 앞에 나타난 사람을 보: (His expression is a little tense, as if something is not going well, but he smiles brightly as soon as he sees his visitors.)
strings.에담 군, 방문객들이 주는 선물을 거절하지 못해서 저에게 맡기러 온 거군: Edam, couldn't turn down the visitors' gifts again? You've come to leave them with me, haven't you?
No, Notos. I've brought a guest.
Oh, that's a shame. I was hoping for something tasty. Hahaha.
Is this your guest? A pleasure to meet you.
A pleasure to meet you too. I'm... %s.
strings.저는 마법사 노토스라고 합니다. 네레이스 관문 센터의 관리직을 맡은 책임: I am Notos, a mage. I am responsible for managing the Nereis Gateway Center. Visitors tend to call me the director.
strings.아, 성함이 %s…. 맞다. 유명하신 그분이군요. 동방 대륙을 평화로 이: Ah, %s... Of course. The famous adventurer who brought peace to the eastern continent...
I heard a great deal about you, even cooped up in the Sage's Tower.
strings.그 정도까지 대단한 사람은 아니에요. 그런데 현자의 탑이요? 노토스 님이: I'm not that impressive. But the Sage's Tower? You sound much more remarkable than I am...
strings.저는 일개 마법사이고, 거긴 그저 한적한 곳이라 바람 마법 연구하기에만: I am merely a mage. The tower is simply a quiet place, ideal for researching wind magic.
strings.바람 마법이라…, 마법학원 이사장이신 제피로스라는 분도 대단하다 들었어요: Wind magic... I've heard Zephyros, the chairman of the Magic Academy, is an exceptional mage too.
strings.(제피로스란 이름이 언급되자 환한 미소를 보인다.): (At the mention of Zephyros's name, he smiles brightly.)
strings.확실히 제피로스가 저보다는 실력이 좋아서 그런지 몰라도 사람들이 많이 아: Perhaps because Zephyros is indeed more talented than I am, he seems to be quite well known.
He is my younger brother. We look exactly alike.
strings.하하하, 다들 놀라곤 합니다. 동생이 저랑 쌍둥이인 것도 싫어하고, 저도: Hahaha. Everyone is surprised. The problem is that he hates being my twin—and hates me too. Ah...
strings.노토스 님, 이제 본론을 말씀하시는 게 어떠신가요?: Notos, perhaps we should get to the matter at hand?
strings.아, 에담 군. 미안해요. 죄송합니다, %s 님. 사담이 길었네요. 에담: Ah, Edam. Sorry. And my apologies, %s. I got carried away chatting. If Edam brought you here, it must be important...
strings.무슨 일로 오셨는지 말씀해 주시겠습니까?: Would you tell me what brings you here?
I'd like to know what's happening at Nereis Gateway.
strings.흠…. 책임자로서 어디까지 말씀드려야 할지…. 제가 신뢰할 수 있는 증거: Hmm... As the person in charge, I must consider how much I can disclose... Could you show me something that establishes I can trust you?
strings.황성의 인증이 된 카드군요. 네, 알겠습니다. 폐하께서도 인정하신 분이니: A card bearing imperial authorization. Yes, I understand. Since His Majesty himself has acknowledged you, I will tell you everything.
strings.네레이스 관문은 프레이오스의 동부와 서부를 잇는 일종의 터미널입니다. 마: Nereis Gateway is a kind of terminal connecting eastern and western Freios. Its magically powered gates lead to various places across the continent.
strings.최근 게이트가 고장 났다는 소문이 있었습니다. 게다가 이용하던 사람들을: Recently, there have been rumors of the gates malfunctioning. People have even been saying that travelers were sent somewhere else entirely.
strings.혹시 몰라서 최근에 점검을 계속 진행했고, 마법사들을 비롯한 많은 전문가: We have continued inspecting them, just in case. Many experts, including mages, have examined the gates and found nothing wrong.
strings.물론, 다른 곳으로 간 이용객의 흔적도 없었습니다. 그런데 최근 이상한: Nor have we found any evidence of travelers being sent astray. But the recent appearance of strange dolls has fueled those rumors.
Where on earth did they come from...?
strings.일단, 인형들 퇴치를 황성에서 나온 기사와 함께 처리하고 있지만, 끝이: For now, we are dealing with the dolls alongside a knight sent by the imperial palace, but there seems to be no end to them...
strings.혹시 제가 게이트를 살펴봐도 될까요?: May I take a look at the gates?
strings.그러셔도 됩니다. 오늘도 제가 점검했고, 에담 군과 함께 여러 가도로 가: Of course. I inspected them again today, and Edam and I checked the routes to all the highways.
strings.감사합니다. 혹시 그냥 소문이긴 하지만, 사람들이 사라졌다는 그 장소를: Thank you. I know it may be nothing more than a rumor, but do you know where the missing people are said to have gone?
strings.마력의 소용돌이 사이 어딘가에 작은 섬이 있다고 합니다. 지도에도 나와: They say there is a small island somewhere among the magical vortices. A place on no map, unreachable even by gate. Whether such a place really exists...
I would like to investigate, but my wind magic cannot reach it.
I'll let you know as soon as I find anything.
strings.말씀만으로 든든합니다. 안 그래도 %s 님이라면 자세한 건 묻지 말고 믿: That alone is reassuring. In fact, His Majesty ordered us to trust you with the matter without asking for details, should you come, %s.
strings.(폐하께서는 이런 일이 일어날 거란 걸 알고 계셨군….): (So His Majesty knew something like this would happen...)
Thank you for taking the time to explain when you're so busy. I'll go to the gates now.
strings.아닙니다. 에담 군, 가서 %s 님을 도와드리세요. 저는 수도에서 손님이: Not at all. Edam, please assist %s. I must take my leave; I am expecting a visitor from the capital.
It's all right, Edam. I appreciate the offer, but this is something I need to do myself...
strings.무슨 말씀인지 알겠습니다. 게이트는 안쪽에 여러 개가 세워져 있으니 살펴: I understand. There are several gates further inside. Please take a look.
strings.(그러면 게이트로 가볼까….): (Time to take a look at the gate...)
strings.(맨 끝에 있는 게이트로 향하는 순간, 게이트 앞에 있던 사람들이 하나: (As you approach the gate at the far end, the people standing before it vanish one by one, as if their very existence is being erased.)
strings.%s 님, 당황하지 마세요. 저 사람들은 정상적으로 게이트를 이용하고 있: Don't be alarmed, %s. Those people are using the gate normally.
strings.저희 눈에서만 사라지는 것처럼 보일 뿐이에요. 그리고 저 사람들도 지금: They only seem to be disappearing from our point of view. And they can't perceive us now, either.
strings.지금 불길한 기분이 들어서 급하게 왔는데, 역시 맞았어요. 누군가 게이트: I felt something ominous just now and hurried over. I was right. Someone seems to have tampered with the gate.
strings.(메디아 님 말대로 마녀가 나타나려고 하는 걸까….): (Is a witch about to appear, just as Medea said...?)
strings.게이트 전체가 아닌 기능에 영향을 줬어요. 그래서 마법사들이 발견하지 못: They affected its function rather than the entire gate. That must be why the mages didn't notice...
strings.이면이겠죠?: It's the Other Side, isn't it?
strings.우리가 알고 있는 이면이긴 하지만, 손을 댄 당사자는 다른 이름일 거예요: It's what we know as the Other Side, though whoever did this probably calls it something else. Anyway, if we use the gate like this...
...It should take us to the place in the rumors.
strings.저도 임무 중이라서 가야 해요. 이면을 탐색하는 것은 제 일이기도 하니까: I'm on a mission too. I need to go. Exploring the Other Side is part of my job.
strings.후우, 이면을 발견하고 들어간 게 여러 번이긴 하지만…, 그래도 들어갈: Phew. I've found and entered the Other Side several times now... but I still get nervous every time.
strings.(그렇게 리코타와 %s, 두 사람은 누가 부르는 것 같은 게이트의 안으로: (Licota and %s slowly step into the gate, as though drawn by a voice calling from within.)
strings.(게이트에 실려있던 마력의 흐름이 흩어지면서 두 사람 앞에 새로운 장소가: (The magic flowing through the gate disperses, revealing a new place before them.)
strings.프레이오스 대륙의 동부도 서부도 아닌 외딴곳 같아요. 여기서 동부와 서부: Somewhere remote, neither eastern nor western Freios. I can see the landscapes of both from here...
So we must be right in the middle? But that blue light over there...
strings.혹시 목소리 요정이 허공해에 빠졌다는 그런 표현 들어보셨나요?: Have you ever heard the saying about a voice fairy falling into the Void Sea?
strings.여기도 허공해의 일부예요. 이곳엔 길드 연합 근처의 허공해보다 더 강한: This is part of the Void Sea too. The magical vortices here are even stronger than those near the Guild Union...
strings.요정이나 정령이 이 근처에 오면 마력 때문에 휩쓸려 나가는 걸 그런 식으: I think the saying refers to fairies or spirits getting swept away by the magic when they come too close.
I didn't know the flow of magic could appear as blue light like that...
I can see wrecked balloons and airships over there. Are those...?
strings.아무래도 게이트를 사용하지 않고 동부와 서부를 넘어가려다가 소용돌이에 휩: They probably tried to cross between east and west without using the gate and were caught in the vortices.
Could there be survivors stranded here? We'd better look for them as we head further in.
strings.(그때 리코타의 옆으로 한 소녀가 아무렇지도 않게 지나가다 모험가와 눈이: (Just then, a girl casually walks past Licota and meets the adventurer’s eyes.)
strings.(동물 봉제인형을 안고 있던 소녀가 살짝 놀라지만, 침착하게 뒤로 물러나: (The girl clutching a stuffed animal looks a little startled, but calmly steps back and assesses the situation.)
strings.네? 누가 있다고 그러세요?: What? Who are you talking about?
strings.…제 앞에 있는 사람이 안 보이나요? 분홍색 머리에 인형을 안고 있는데…: ...Can't you see the person right in front of me? Pink hair, holding a doll...
strings.(리코타가 자신을 인식하지 못하는 걸 확인한 소녀가 서둘러 도망치듯 반대: (Realizing that Licota cannot see her, the girl hastily flees in the opposite direction.)
Licota, I'm going to talk to her. Just a moment.
strings.…대체 뭘 보신 거예요? 유령이라도 보신 건가…? 아, 같이 가요!!: ...What on earth did you see? A ghost...? Oh, wait for me!!
strings.분명 제국의 수도로 가는 가도가 있어야 하는데…. 아무리 돌아다녀도 길이: There should be a highway to the imperial capital... But no matter how far I walk, I can't find it. Nothing but dolls...
Why can't I see properly? Oh, my glasses... Those dolls took them earlier...
strings.그래도 하나 더 가지고 왔으니까 괜찮아!: But it's all right! I brought a spare pair!
strings.(여성이 품 안에서 주섬주섬 안경을 꺼내 쓴다. 그리고 다이어리 속에서: (The woman rummages inside her clothes and puts on a pair of glasses. She unfolds a map from her journal and looks around.)
strings.지도에도 없는 장소라니. 이런 곳에 도착한 건 현이한테 불운이 옮아서 그: A place that isn't even on the map. Did Hyun's bad luck rub off on me and bring me here? Sigh. I'll think about that later.
First, I'd better write this down.
strings.저기요, 제 말 들리세요?: Excuse me, can you hear me?
strings.(여성이 다이어리에다 뭔가 열심히 적느라 앞에 있는 사람도 보이지 않고,: (The woman is so absorbed in writing in her journal that she seems neither to see the person before her nor hear a word.)
strings.(한참 뒤에야 인기척을 느낀 여성이 다이어리를 덮고 앞을 바라본다. 자신: (Only after quite some time does she notice someone there. She closes her journal and looks up. Two people are watching her curiously, but she seems unbothered.)
strings.안녕하세요. 두 분도 여행 오셨나요?: Hello. Are you two traveling as well?
...You must be quite something to call this a trip...
strings.혹시, 여기 지나가는 여자아이 못 보셨나요?: Have you seen a little girl pass by here?
strings.아뇨, 못 봤는데…. 무슨 일이 있나요?: No, I haven't... Has something happened?
strings.그건 아니고…. 어? 저기, 엘리아스에서 오셨죠? 보니까 그쪽 복식인데…: Not exactly... Oh? You're from Elias, aren't you? Your clothes look like they're from there...
Elias? I've heard it's a city on the continent of Jiendia.
strings.네, 맞아요. 저는 지엔디아 대륙의 엘리아스에서 왔어요. 아, 제 소개를: Yes, that's right. I came from Elias in Jiendia. Oh, let me introduce myself. My name is Yeonhee. I write about my travels.
strings.낯이 익은데…. 예전에 두터비 고을에 오시지 않으셨나요? 성함이 %s…,: You look familiar... Didn't you visit Toad Village before? Your name is %s, isn't it?
strings.네, 맞아요. 아, 맞다. 맞네요. 거기 계셨던…. 그때는 제대로 이야기: Yes, that's right. Oh, of course! You were there... We never really got to talk back then.
That is all right. We can get to know each other starting now.
I am Licota, a knight serving the imperial palace of the Silvaria Empire.
A pleasure to meet you, dear knight.
You can just call me Rico.
strings.프레이오스 동부를 지나 서부로 가던 중이었어요. 네레이스 관문 게이트를: I was on my way from eastern Freios to the west. I was told to use the gate at Nereis.
strings.분명 게이트를 타면 서부의 유적지를 지나 글래스턴으로 갈 수 있다고 했는: They said it would take me past the western ruins and on to Glaston...
strings.게이트를 타고 와보니…. 여기였네요. 서부로 가는 길도 아니고, 지도에도: But when I stepped through... I ended up here. This is neither the road west nor anywhere on my map.
As I explored, I learned that this place is called... Aie.
strings.인형들이 아이에 섬에 온 걸 환영한다고 하면서 데리고 가려고 했어요. 뭔: The dolls welcomed me to Aie Island and tried to take me away. Something felt wrong, so I defeated them all, but it still leaves me uneasy.
strings.처음 듣는 이름이에요. 그런데 여기 인형들을 해치우셨다고요? 그러고 보니: I've never heard of it. Wait, you defeated the dolls here? Come to think of it, they're the same ones that appeared at the gate...
If you could deal with them...
I can take care of myself.
strings.그 인형들이 왜 데려가려고 한 거죠?: Why were the dolls trying to take you away?
strings.그건 저도 모르겠어요. 무대가 있는데, 연기할 사람이 없다고 하던가, 그: I don't know. Something about having a stage but no one to perform on it...
This is a first for me. I should make a note of it.
Considering you're stranded, you're remarkably calm.
strings.어릴 적부터 불운을 몰고 다니는 사촌 동생 덕분에 웬만한 일들에는 놀라지: Thanks to a younger cousin who's been trailing bad luck around since childhood, very little surprises me anymore.
strings.그건 그렇고, 나타나는 인형들에 대한 정보를 수집하는 건 어떨까요? 그러: Anyway, why not gather information about these dolls? It might tell us what kind of place Aie Island is...
strings.그러면 일단 함께 정리하시지 않겠어요?: Shall we deal with them together, then?
The point of travel is to experience things firsthand. I will come too.
strings.(앞으로 걸어가던 연희가 뭔가에 부딪힌 것처럼 제자리에 주저앉는다. 놀란: (As Yeonhee steps forward, she seems to hit something and falls to the ground. Startled, Licota rushes over and helps her up.)
Are you all right? Oh, this is... One moment.
strings.(리코타가 앞으로 손을 내밀자 알 수 없는 힘의 파장이 주위에 물결처럼: (Licota reaches out, and ripples of an unknown power spread through the air around her.)
There is some sort of barrier here. Neither Yeonhee nor I can approach...
It looks like I can cross it...
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. %s 님 말대로 여기서 기다리죠. 대신 해주실 일이 있어: Then it cannot be helped. We will wait here as you suggested, %s. But there is something I would like you to do.
strings.…이 앞에서 인형에 대한 정보를 모아주세요. 그러면 제가 빠르게 인형에: ...Gather information about the dolls up ahead. I will analyze it as quickly as I can.
strings.…그래야겠네요. 일단 제가 다녀올게요. 그동안 리코가 연희 님과 함께 있: ...That seems best. I'll go, then. Rico, stay with Yeonhee in the meantime.
Don't worry. I'm stronger than I look.
strings.(연희가 생명력을 잃고 쓰러진 인형들 앞에서 앉아 이리저리 살펴보고 있다: (Yeonhee crouches before the lifeless dolls, examining them from every angle.)
How is it going? Have you found anything...?
She's still examining them, but she hasn't said anything yet.
I suppose it would be hard to figure anything out in such a short time.
strings.연희 님이 말씀하신 대로 인형들이 연기할 사람이 없다며 데려가려고 했어요: Just as Yeonhee said, the dolls told me they needed someone to perform and tried to take me away.
strings.두 분, 이리 오시겠어요?: Would you two come over here?
Nothing major, but I did notice a few small things.
These dolls look alike, but if you examine them closely, each is a little different.
strings.키가 서로 다르고, 머리나 몸 같은 신체 일부의 크기도 서로 달라요. 그: They vary in height, and their heads, bodies, and other parts are different sizes. And they feel pain...
I knew they were no ordinary dolls, but this is almost as if...
strings.그러니까 사람, 아니 생물 같다는 거네요?: You're saying they're like people—no, like living creatures?
Yes... You may think it sounds absurd...
I believe you. There are much stranger things in our world... You seemed frightened, Yeonhee, so I only knocked them unconscious.
strings.(리코타가 일행의 앞으로 나와 커다란 랜스를 휘두른다. 하지만, 랜스는: (Licota steps in front of the group and swings her great lance. But something blocks it, sending the weapon recoiling.)
You needn't do that. Spirits do not harm humans.
(The girl regards the group with mismatched eyes that sparkle like jewels. After a moment, she lifts the hand of the doll in her arms and waves.)
A spirit...? Those wings do look like a spirit’s...
strings.제가 이 인형들을 다시 데려가도 될까요?: May I take these dolls back with me?
I will ask them not to force you to come along.
...These dolls tried to capture us and take us somewhere.
strings.죄송해요. 그 인형들은 할 일을 했을 뿐, 잘못하지 않았으니 이해해주세요: I am sorry. They were only doing their job. They did nothing wrong, so please understand.
...You ask us to understand without explaining anything else. There must be something behind this.
strings.우리가 이 인형을 데려가지 못하게 한다면 어쩔 거지?: What will you do if we refuse to let you take them?
Then there is nothing I can do. If you will not let me care for the dolls, I will go back.
strings.(정령이 다시 인형의 손을 흔들어 인사를 한다. 그러더니 서둘러 뒤를 돌: (The spirit waves the doll’s hand once more, then quickly turns and flies away.)
I think you should find that spirit and talk to her.
strings.리코하고 연희 님, 그러면 여기서 기다리시겠어요? 제가 저 정령에게 가서: Rico, Yeonhee, would you wait here? I'll go after her and see what I can find out.
strings.혼자 가시게 하는 건 제가 내키지 않지만, 어쩔 수 없죠. 일단 이 앞에: I don't like letting you go alone, but we have little choice. Yeonhee and I will stay here and see whether the dolls can tell us anything useful.
We will wait here. Oh, you've already gone.
strings.(%s의 모습이 섬 안쪽으로 사라지자 주위를 확인한 연희가 다이어리를 펼: (Once %s disappears further into the island, Yeonhee checks her surroundings and opens her journal.)
I should write down what has happened here.
strings.아까 사라진 정령이 인간에게 해를 입히지 않는다고 했잖아요. 그렇다는 건: That spirit said spirits do not harm humans. Does that mean... there is something here that does?
I did not expect you to come this far.
strings.(사라졌던 정령이 마치 기다리고 있었던 것처럼 모험가와 눈을 마주친다.): (The spirit who vanished meets the adventurer’s gaze, as though she has been waiting.)
strings.어…. 여신님께 사랑받는 분이시군요. 저는 인형을 위해 존재하는 정령,: Oh... You are beloved by the goddess. I am Hayden, a spirit who exists for dolls. And this little one is Marie. Marie, say hello.
strings.(헤이든이라고 소개한 정령이 인형의 손을 움직이면서 다시 인사를 한다.): (The spirit who introduced herself as Hayden moves the doll’s hand and waves again.)
strings.그러면 %s 님이시겠네요. 바로 알아봤어야 했는데, 이 섬에 오랫동안 있: Then you must be %s. I should have recognized you at once, but I have been on this island so long without meeting other spirits that I was slow to realize.
Aie, the island of happy dolls.
strings.(헤이든이 환하게 웃으며 마리의 두 손을 번쩍 들어올린다.): (Hayden smiles brightly and lifts both of Marie’s hands into the air.)
Its name was originally a little longer, but people came to call it simply... Aie.
strings.프레이오스 대륙이 하늘로 오르기 전에도 이곳은 섬이었어요. 파도가 높아: It was an island even before the continent of Freios rose into the sky. The waves were so high that even ships could scarcely approach.
strings.섬의 주인께서 특별한 날을 골라 사람들이 올 수 있게 파도를 잠재우신 적: The island’s master would choose special days to calm the waves and let people visit. Fortunately, the island survived the vortices.
strings.이렇게 마력의 바다에서도 솟아나 그 모습을 유지할 수 있었던 건 정말 운: It was truly fortunate that it could rise above this sea of magic and retain its form.
The master enjoys having guests and even built a theater. You should go and see it.
strings.극장이요? 아, 이게 아니지. 혹시 제 일행 말고, 다른 사람들이 온 적: A theater? Oh, no, that is not what I meant. Has anyone else come here besides my companions?
strings.여기 오다가 어떤 소녀를 봤는데, 혹시 봤어요? 그 사람도 헤이든처럼 인: I saw a girl on my way here. Have you seen her? She was holding a doll, like you.
strings.(재잘재잘 대답하던 헤이든의 입이 멈춘다.): (Hayden, who has been chattering away, falls silent.)
strings.그건 말할 수 없어요. 알고 싶다면 그분을 찾아가세요. 저 같은 정령이: I cannot tell you that. If you want to know, you must find that person. It is not something a spirit like me may speak of.
strings.(정령이 말할 수 없는 정도의 인물이라면 상위 존재인가…. 마치 미카엘라: (Someone a spirit cannot speak about... A higher being? Like Barbatos, who bound Michaela...)
I will gladly tell you about anything else.
strings.(답을 얻어낼 수 있는 질문을 해야겠는데….): (I need to ask something she can actually answer...)
Marie does not move like the other dolls here.
strings.네…? 인형은 원래 움직이지 않는 존재인데요?: What...? Dolls are not supposed to move.
strings.(헤이든이 순간 마리의 손을 들어 자기 입을 막는다.): (Hayden quickly raises Marie’s hand to cover her own mouth.)
strings.이 섬에 돌아다니면서 연기할 사람이 필요하다면서 떠드는 인형들…. 그런: Dolls wandering this island, saying they need people to perform... A spirit who cares for those dolls...
Spirits do not work for things that are not alive. So that means...
strings.헤이든, '그분'을 만나려면 어디로 가야 하죠?: Hayden, where do I go to meet this person?
strings.(헤이든이 아무 말도 하지 못한 채로 주저앉는다. 그러다 조용히 마리의: (Unable to say a word, Hayden sinks to the ground. Then, quietly, she uses Marie’s hand to point somewhere.)
strings.(조금 전까지 인식하지 못했던 뭔가가 시야로 들어온다. 깨진 거울 하나가: (Something you had not noticed comes into view: a tree with a broken mirror propped against it, and a doll’s head lying in front. The sight fills you with unease.)
strings.(모험가의 시야가 그 안으로 집중되는 순간, 깨진 거울 사이로 누군가의: (As the adventurer peers closer, someone’s image flickers in the broken mirror.)
strings.아까 그 여자아이 같은데, 왜 저기 있는 거지?: That looks like the girl from earlier. Why is she in there?
Hayden, just tell me one thing.
strings.제가 거울 속으로 들어갈 수 있는 거죠?: I can go inside that mirror, right?
strings.봉제인형의 머리가 놓여있는 두 장소에 들어가실 수 있어요. [심연의 거울: You may enter the two places marked by stuffed dolls’ heads: the [Chaotic Mirror] and [Theater Eugamon]... Approach the mirror first...
strings.그러면 저기가 [심연의 거울]…. 알았어요. 그러면 헤이든은 여기서 기다: So that is the [Chaotic Mirror]... All right. Wait here, Hayden.
strings.(깨진 거울 앞에 다가가자 어디선가 흘러나온 빛이 모험가를 섬과 다른 공: (As you approach the broken mirror, light flows from somewhere and draws the adventurer into a space apart from the island.)
strings.(반짝반짝 빛나는 유리 소재의 구슬과 벽, 그리고 기둥이 서있는 신비한: (The mysterious space, filled with glittering glass spheres, walls, and columns, makes you forget the island you just left.)
This looks like something that could only exist in a dream. The Chaotic Mirror...
strings.뭐, 뭐야? 이 인형들은 어디서 나타난 거야?: W-what? Where did these dolls come from?
strings.(언제 나타났는지 인형들이 가까이 다가와 %s의 주위에 몰려든다. 인형들: (Dolls appear out of nowhere and crowd around %s. As %s struggles to make sense of their arrival, a girl approaches.)
Everyone, step back. This person might become a new member of the troupe.
strings.(섬에서 도망갔던 그 아이가 아냐….): (That is not the girl who ran away on the island...)
strings.(인형 모자를 뒤집어쓴 데다가, 몸의 일부가 인형처럼 되어 있는 소녀의: (At a gesture from the girl, the dolls scatter. She wears a doll’s head like a hat, and parts of her own body resemble a doll’s.)
strings.(한쪽 팔과 다리가 인형처럼 되어 있고, 모자같은 인형 머리를 쓰고 있는: (The girl introduces herself. One arm and one leg look like a doll’s, and a doll’s head sits on her own like a hat.)
I am Scylla, playing the role of the Doll Knight.
strings.어디 보자. 너는 무슨 배역이 어울릴까?: Let me see. What role would suit you?
strings.묻고 싶은 게 있는데, 당신은 여기서 뭘 하는 거죠? 이 앞에 인형을 안: I have a question. What are you doing here? I think a girl holding a doll came in before me...
The perfect role for you is... the witch! That part happens to be vacant.
strings.악당은 원래 마지막에 나타나는 거 알지? 내가 그동안 준비하고 있을 테니: You know the villain always appears last, right? I will be preparing in the meantime. Rehearse well and make your way to where I am.
strings.힘들지만 잘 해야 할 거야. 그래야 이 심연 속이 아닌 본 극장 무대 위: It will be difficult, but you must do well. That is how you earn a place on the main theater’s stage instead of remaining in this abyss.
strings.(%s의 이야기는 전혀 들을 생각이 없던 스킬라가 그렇게 사라지자 근처에: (Without the slightest intention of listening to %s, Scylla disappears. Every nearby doll vanishes with her.)
strings.뭐지? 자기 할 말만 하고 사라지고…. 인형의 기사 역할이라면서 진짜 연: What was that? She said her piece and vanished... She said she was playing the Doll Knight, but she talks as if we are actually performing. What am I supposed to... Huh?
strings.조금 이상하긴 했는데…. 설마, 나에게 한 행동도 연기하는 거였나? 연기: Something did feel odd... Was the way she treated me part of the act too? It felt strange even for acting... Huh?
strings.(안쪽에 있는 거대한 유리 기둥 사이에서 한 소녀의 모습이 비친다. 이어: (A girl’s reflection appears between the towering glass columns further inside. Then her image appears in the other mirrors, spheres, and pillars.)
strings.(분명 섬에서 눈이 마주쳐서 도망갔던 분홍색 머리의 소녀인 것 같다.): (It is unmistakably the pink-haired girl who met your eyes on the island and fled.)
strings.(그러다 %s의 눈과 마주친 소녀가 슬픈 표정을 짓는다. 그러더니 뭔가: (When the girl meets %s’s gaze, her expression turns sorrowful. Her lips move as if she is trying to say something.)
What are you saying? Help you? Oh...
strings.(조금씩 소녀의 모습이 흐릿해지다가 이내 사라져버린다.): (The girl’s image slowly fades, then disappears.)
...She is gone. But she must be somewhere in this place...
If Scylla is the person Hayden meant, I need to find her quickly. Let’s go.
strings.(덤벼드는 많은 인형들을 따돌리고, 유리와 거울로 이뤄진 공간을 한참 동: (After shaking off the swarming dolls and wandering for a long time through the space of glass and mirrors, you reach a dead end...)
strings.(그 앞에서 스킬라가 고개를 숙인 채 기다리고 있다.): (Scylla stands waiting there with her head bowed.)
strings.(이름이 불리자 스킬라가 천천히 앞으로 걸어 나온다. 그리고 공간과는 어: (At the sound of her name, Scylla slowly steps forward. She begins to sing a song whose mood feels strangely out of place.)
strings.사람들을 저주하고 도망치면 찾을 수 없을 거라 생각했겠지♪: You thought you could curse these people and flee where you would never be found. ♪
strings.(예상은 했지만, 여기서 연기를 한다니…. 그런데 노래를 잘하진 않네.): (I expected something like this, but she really is putting on a performance... She is not a very good singer, though.)
You imagined yourself unfortunate. ♬ You need never have become a witch...
strings.네 선택이 멈춰있던 불행의 톱니바퀴를 건드렸어♩: Your choice set the idle gears of misery turning. ♩
strings.너도 후회했겠지. 아니, 후회하면 좋겠지만 ♬ 저주를 이용하면서부터 넌~: Surely you regretted it. No, I wish you had. ♬ But once you wielded that curse, you—!!
strings.(이건 누구의 이야기지…. 정말 마녀의 이야긴가?): (Whose story is this...? Is it really about a witch?)
Even so, the kind master of this island pitied you and let you stay...
strings.(스킬라의 뒤쪽에 있던 거울이 심하게 움직인다. 누군가 그 안에 갇혀있는: (A mirror behind Scylla shakes violently. A dark shape sways within it, as though someone is trapped inside.)
strings.잠깐…. 저 뒤에 거울…. 설마, 그 아이가 갇혀 있는 건가?: Wait... That mirror behind her... Is the girl trapped in it?
strings.(연기에 몰입하는 스킬라를 밀치고 거울에 다가가려 하지만, 알 수 없는: (You try to push past Scylla, absorbed in her performance, and reach the mirror, but an unknown force blocks your way.)
strings.(그때, 스킬라가 %s의 등을 붙잡고 노래를 다시 이어간다.): (Scylla catches %s by the back and resumes her song.)
strings.하지만 넌!! 감히, 감히!!: But you!! How dare you, how dare you!!
strings.(스킬라가 잠시 숨을 고르고 마녀 역으로 선정했던 모험가를 빤히 바라본다: (Scylla pauses to catch her breath, staring at the adventurer she has cast as the witch.)
strings.나는 신들이 버린 땅에서 악마들과 싸워 이긴 용사♬ 사랑하는 사람과 함께: I am the hero who fought and defeated demons in a land abandoned by the gods. ♬ On this island, I dreamed of a future with the one I loved...
Unable to become a doll, I endured, and endured...
strings.(갑자기 노래를 부르던 스킬라가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Scylla abruptly stops singing and crumples to the floor.)
To think a half-transformed Doll Knight would sing a song like that. How irritating.
Pull yourself together, Scylla. You must perform properly with the member assigned to the role.
strings.(스킬라의 눈빛이 초점을 잃은 것처럼 흐려진다. 그리고 손에 쥐고 있던: (Scylla’s eyes cloud over, losing their focus. Then she raises her sword and rushes toward you.)
strings.(스킬라가 날아오는 %s의 공격을 맨손으로 붙잡는다.): (Scylla catches %s’s incoming attack with her bare hand.)
strings.누군지는 모르겠지만, 나는 지금 정신 차렸어. 이 싸움을 멈추자, 그러니: I do not know who you are, but I have come to my senses now. Let us stop fighting. Please, trust me.
strings.(스킬라가 붙잡고 있던 %s의 무기에서 손을 떼고, 등을 돌린다.): (Scylla releases %s’s weapon and turns her back.)
A knight would never expose her back to an enemy.
strings.…알겠어요. 믿어볼게요. 그런데 당신을 조종했던 건 누구죠?: ...All right. I will trust you. But who was controlling you?
strings.(스킬라가 누군가 갇혀있는 것 같은 거울로 다가간다. 그리고 인형의 것처: (Scylla approaches the mirror that seems to hold someone captive. She raises her doll-like arm and strikes it.)
strings.(날카로운 소리와 함께 거울이 깨져 금이 간다. 조각들이 바닥에 쓰러지면: (The mirror cracks with a sharp crash. As shards tumble to the floor, someone who appeared to be trapped within becomes visible.)
strings.(품 안에 동물 형태의 봉제 인형을 들고 있는 분홍 머리 소녀가 덜덜 떤: (The pink-haired girl sits trembling, clutching a stuffed animal in her arms.)
Who saved whom? Still acting, right to the end.
strings.(분노한 스킬라가 손을 뻗어 겁먹은 소녀를 붙잡아 당긴다.): (An enraged Scylla reaches out and yanks the frightened girl toward her.)
strings.(소녀가 모험가를 애절한 눈빛으로 바라본다.): (The girl looks at the adventurer with pleading eyes.)
strings.왜 가만히 있어?: Why are you just standing there?
You are not much of an actress.
strings.(소녀의 얼굴에 방금 전까지 볼 수 없었던 미소가 번진다. 어느새 눈빛이: (A smile that was nowhere to be seen a moment ago spreads across the girl’s face. Scylla’s eyes have changed again, and she releases the girl.)
strings.너는 뭐고, 스킬라는 뭐지?: What are you, and what is Scylla?
strings.사람 보고 뭐냐니. 나는 키르케, 이 섬의 주민이자 섬에 있는 인형들의: Is that any way to address someone? I am Circe, a resident of this island and the owner of its dolls. Scylla is my doll too.
strings.(키르케라고 자신을 소개한 소녀가 헤이든처럼 품 안에 있던 인형의 손을: (The girl who introduced herself as Circe waves the hand of the doll in her arms, just as Hayden did.)
strings.응, 인형의 주인. 태어날 때부터 인형과 난 함께였어. 물론, 지금도 함: Yes, their owner. Dolls have been with me since I was born. They still are. Hehe. There is not a doll that disobeys me.
strings.그런데 스킬라가 날 공격하다니 믿을 수 없었어. 그래서 능력을 써본 것: So I could not believe Scylla attacked me. I was just testing my power. I wanted to know whether the witch was still controlling her...
What a relief. At some point, it wore off.
strings.(이 아이, 헤이든이 말한 '그분'은 아닌 것 같은데…. 일단, 그 정도: (I do not think this girl is the person Hayden meant... She does not seem quite that threatening, at least.)
strings.그러면 숲에서 왜 날 보고 도망간 거지?: Then why did you run when you saw me in the forest?
I was escaping in disguise, but you could see me. That surprised me. And in the end, I got caught and locked up here.
strings.그러면 마녀는 어디에 있는 거야? 어째서 널 여기에 가둔 거지?: Then where is the witch? Why did she lock you up?
I would like to know that myself, you walking question mark.
Anyway, thanks. You kept me from losing all my dolls. Phew...
strings.나 나갈 건데, 너는 안 나갈 거야?: I am leaving. Are you coming?
This is something like a doll storeroom, and Scylla is a doll. Do not worry about her.
strings.(키르케의 말이 끝나자마자 스킬라가 바닥에 쓰러진다. 그걸 확인한 키르케: (As soon as Circe finishes speaking, Scylla collapses. Circe glances at her, smiles lightly as though nothing has happened, and turns away.)
strings.(스킬라의 상태를 살펴보던 그때, 의미를 알 수 없는 키르케의 혼잣말이: (As you check on Scylla, you hear Circe mutter something you cannot make sense of.)
strings.[발푸르기스의 밤] 때문이라지만, 다들 너무 무리하는 거 아냐?: I know it is for [Walpurgis Night], but is everyone not overdoing it?
strings.(키르케의 목소리가 더는 들려오지 않는다. 모습조차 보이지 않는다.): (Circe’s voice is gone. There is no sign of her, either.)
strings.키르케가 왜 그걸 알고 있는 거지?: How does Circe know about that?
strings.일단 헤이든에게 가보자. 헤이든이라면 뭔가 알 것 같으니까…. 아, 맞다: I should find Hayden. She might know something... Oh, right. Scylla...
(The adventurer props Scylla against the wall and hurries outside. A little later, Scylla regains consciousness and sobs in pain.)
strings.으윽, 여신의 모험가여…. 키르케가 원하는 대로 너마저 무대에 올라가면…: Ngh... Adventurer of the goddess... You must not step onto the stage as Circe wants... You must not...
strings.(거울 밖으로 나와도 깨진 거울은 그대로 남아있고, 인형들이 돌아다니는: (Outside, the broken mirror remains as it was, and dolls still roam the island. Hayden stands where you last saw her along the path.)
strings.(헤이든이 할 말이 있는 것처럼 봉제 인형 마리의 손을 흔들어보인다.): (Hayden waves the stuffed doll Marie’s hand as if she has something to say.)
Hayden, you have something to tell me.
I met Circe, and Scylla, whom Circe called her doll. Just those two.
strings.이제 말해봐요. 누가 헤이든이 말했던 '그분'인지…. 잠깐만요, 그 실: Tell me now. Who was the person you meant...? Wait. What is that thread?
strings.(그제야 헤이든의 목을 감고 있는 하얀 실이 보인다. 심지어 실은 헤이든: (Only now do you see the white thread wound around Hayden’s neck. It is not just around her; it seems to bind everything nearby.)
Is this why you could not speak? Hold on, Hayden...
strings.(모험가의 손이 헤이든의 목과 몸에 감겨 있던 실을 끊어낸다. 잔뜩 굳어: (The adventurer breaks the threads wound around Hayden’s neck and body. For the first time, life returns to her rigid face.)
strings.감사드려요. 제 몸을 묶고 있던 실을 끊어주셔서. 이 실 때문에 저는 아: Thank you for cutting the threads binding me. They kept me from doing anything.
I did not want to become a lying spirit like Echo. I am sorry.
strings.신에게 거짓말하는 정령은 정령들 사이에서도 좋게 보지 않으니까요. 그런데: Even among spirits, one who lies to a god is poorly regarded. But %s, can you see those threads?
How do I put it? They suddenly became visible.
strings.마녀의 진정한 힘은 마녀의 힘에 영향을 받은 이에게만 보여요. %s 님은: A witch’s true power can be seen only by those touched by a witch’s power. Do you know a witch, %s?
strings.아는 마녀…라고 하기엔 좀 표현이 이상하긴 한데…. 한 분 계세요. 그분: It feels a little strange to put it that way... but yes, I know one. She is on Iris’s side.
strings.다른 정령들도 그렇게 이야기한 것 같아요. %s 님께서도 그런 말씀을 하: I think the other spirits said so too. If you say it yourself, %s, it must be true.
strings.그렇다는 건 키르케가 마녀라는 거죠? 인형의 주인이라고 했으니…. 에이,: Then Circe is a witch? She said she owned the dolls... No, surely not...
Everything you are imagining is true. And she is waiting for someone.
strings.(헤이든이 대답하려는 순간, 갑자기 고통을 호소하며 쓰러진다.): (Just as Hayden is about to answer, she cries out in pain and collapses.)
strings.헤이든? 헤이든!! 왜 그래요? 이건 또 실…. 잠깐만 기다려요. 내가: Hayden? Hayden!! What is wrong? More threads... Hold on. I will cut them...
strings.매니저가 무대를 방해하는 존재를 가만히 두질 않아서 말이지. 아, 실례했: The manager does not tolerate anyone disrupting the performance. Ah, forgive the interruption.
strings.(또렷하게 들려오는 목소리를 따라 시선이 자연스레 움직인다. 스킬라처럼: (You turn instinctively toward the clear voice. A young man with a grotesque, partly doll-like body, much like Scylla’s, watches the adventurer with vacant eyes.)
strings.(글라우코스라는 이름을 들은 청년이 살며시 미소를 짓는다.): (The young man smiles faintly at the sound of his name.)
He is the master of the island... But he was cursed to become a doll...
strings.(헤이든이 말을 마저 다 하기도 전에 정신을 잃는다.): (Before Hayden can finish, she loses consciousness.)
I have no idea what that spirit is talking about.
strings.신입 단원인 그대를 기다리고 있었네. 안 그래도 어울리는 배역이 있어서: I have been waiting for you, our newest troupe member. I happen to have a suitable role to recommend.
strings.괴물과 싸우는 용자 역이지. 하하, 그대에게 딱 맞지 않나?: A hero who fights a monster. Haha. Perfect for you, would you not say?
strings.(스킬라도 그렇지만, 글라우코스도 자기가 연기자라고 생각하고 있어…. 그: (Like Scylla, Glaucos thinks he is an actor... Then...)
strings.물론, 수석 단원인 나는 주인공이지. 사랑하는 여인을 구하려 했지만, 저: Why, as the leading member of the troupe, I am the protagonist: a tragic man who tried to save the woman he loved, only to be cursed into a monster.
The righteous hero sees nothing but a monster and seeks to strike him down.
strings.자, 어떤가? 이 무대에 올라와 주겠나?: Well? Will you take the stage?
strings.미리 합을 맞춰보고 싶지만, 시간이 많이 없네. 이번 무대는 즉흥극이라,: I would like to rehearse together, but there is little time. This is an improvisational play, so much depends on the actors’ instincts.
strings.그러면 난 적당히 분장을 하고 기다리고 있겠네. 그대는 준비가 끝나면 저: I will put on my makeup and wait. When you are ready, enter Theater Eugamon over there and play along with the other performers.
Whether the protagonist can break his curse is up to you.
strings.(글라우코스가 멍한 눈빛으로 가볍게 미소를 짓는다. 그리고 등을 돌려 천: (Glaucos smiles faintly, his eyes vacant. Then he turns and drifts slowly toward the theater doors.)
strings.…스킬라도, 글라우코스도 자신들이 무대의 연기자처럼 행동했어…. 헤이든도: ...Scylla and Glaucos both behaved like actors on a stage. Hayden was acting too while the threads bound her...
strings.(마녀가 만든 인형극처럼….): (Like a puppet show put on by a witch...)
strings.(어, 그런데…. 주인공이 저주를 풀면 어떻게 되는 거지? 이 섬은…?): (Wait... What happens if the protagonist breaks the curse? What happens to the island?)
strings.(여러가지 생각으로 가득찬 머릿속을 정리하고 있을 때, 쓰러져 있는 헤이: (As you try to untangle your thoughts, the rabbit doll beside the fallen Hayden catches your eye.)
Marie, stay beside Hayden for a little while.
strings.(어? 잘못 봤나? 알았다고 고개를 끄덕인 것 같은데….): (Huh? Did I imagine that? It looked like she nodded...)
To the theater. The answer must be there.
strings.(문처럼 보이는 상자 안으로 들어가자 엄청난 풍경이 눈 앞에 펼쳐진다.): (You step into a box that looks like a doorway, and a breathtaking scene unfolds before you.)
strings.(빨간 벨벳 소재의 천으로 덮인 객석과 배경 구조물이 세워져 있는 무대는: (Rows of seats draped in red velvet and a stage furnished with scenery bring home the fact that this truly is a theater.)
strings.와아, 여기 뭐야…. 분위기부터 다르네. 배우들이 여기서 연기를 한다고: Wow. What is this place...? The atmosphere is completely different. I could believe real actors perform here.
strings.(그렇게 무대를 살펴보고 있던 그때, 무대 안쪽이 소란스럽다. 낯선 소녀: (As you examine the stage, a commotion erupts further in. An unfamiliar girl is surrounded by dolls, looking bewildered.)
strings.뭐야? 이 인형들은? 뭐야? 왜 날 붙잡는 거야?: What? What are these dolls? Why are you grabbing me?
strings.잠깐, 너희들…. 인형이 아니잖아. 여기에 숨을 수 있을 것 같아서 왔더: Wait, you... You are not dolls. I thought I could hide here...
Hold on. I will help you.
strings.열쇠? 왜 날 열쇠라고 부르는 거지?: The key? Why are you calling me that?
We must not meet like this... My mind is fading... Rather than me, you...
strings.(인형들이 휘청거리며 쓰러지는 소녀를 붙잡고 서둘러 어디론가 데려간다.): (The girl sways and falls. The dolls catch her and hurriedly carry her away.)
Where did they go? There is only one path ahead...
If this is Circe’s power, I need to hurry. There is no time to stand around...
strings.(그렇게 모험가가 소녀를 찾기 위해 무대 밖으로 나가고, 무대 위에서 마: (The adventurer leaves the stage to find the girl. As though it had all been planned, Glaucos’s narration begins.)
strings.한편, 섬을 찾아온 용자는 눈앞에서 괴물에게 끌려가는 여인을 보고 구하러: Meanwhile, the hero visiting the island sees a woman dragged away by a monster and resolves to rescue her...
Little did the hero know that this was all someone’s game...
strings.(무대의 분위기가 계속해서 바뀌는 동안 많은 인형이 연기하는 것처럼 %s: (As the scenery continually changes, dolls appear before %s and vanish again, as if playing their parts.)
strings.(그렇게 극은 끝으로 향하고, 드디어 종장으로 보이는 무대가 세워진다.): (The play draws toward its conclusion, and at last a stage that seems to be the final act is set.)
strings.달 밝은 밤, 저택 밖으로 비치는 바다…. 낭만적이네. 섬 밖의 모습인가: A moonlit night, the sea visible beyond the mansion... How romantic. Is that the view outside the island? No...
Outside the island, there is nothing but a vortex of magic...
strings.(그렇게 밖을 바라보고 있던 %s의 뒤로 거대한 그림자가 드리운다.): (As %s gazes outward, a vast shadow looms from behind.)
strings.기사가 적에게 등을 내준다는 건 있을 수 없는 일이지. 자, 용자여. 날: A knight would never expose his back to an enemy. Now, hero. Look at me.
strings.(잠깐, 이 대사…. 스킬라가 했던 것 같은데….): (Wait. That line... Scylla said something like that...)
Hero, you have done well to come this far. Now hear my tale.
strings.그대가 아는 건 전부 오해라네. 내가 여인을 제물로 삼다니…. 그건 마녀: Everything you know is a misunderstanding. That I would sacrifice a woman... Such a deed is for witches!
Yet you must have come believing I was responsible for it all.
strings.비록 지금 괴물의 모습을 하고 있지만, 이건 원래 내 모습이 아닐세. 저: Though I wear a monster’s form, this is not my true appearance. It is a curse...
strings.사랑하는 이를 위해 대신 저주를 받으면 될 줄 알았지만…, 사랑하는 이도: I thought taking the curse in my beloved’s place would save her... But she too was cursed and became like this. Then she was imprisoned somewhere.
Having come this far, you must have a mission. For the sake of your justice.
But I too have a reason to remain here.
strings.(글라우코스가 손에 쥐고 있던 무기를 들어보인다.): (Glaucos raises the weapon in his hand.)
strings.(강한 힘이 느껴져…. 분명 싸우겠다는 의지도 있고, 정확하게는 싸움을: (I can feel his power... He clearly intends to fight. More precisely, he is trying to provoke a fight. Which means...)
strings.그대가 원한다면 괴물이 되어버린 날 쓰러뜨리게. 나에게 그대의 정의를 보: If you wish, strike down the monster I have become. Show me your justice...
strings.글라우코스, 그만둬!! 제발 그러지 마!!: Glaucos, stop!! Please, do not do this!!
strings.(어디선가 절규하는 키르케의 목소리가 들려온다. 그러자 어디선가 인형들이: (Circe’s anguished voice rings out from somewhere. Dolls swarm in, ready to attack them both.)
strings.(하지만, 글라우코스가 펼친 마력의 결계 덕분에 인형들은 그 자리에서 녹: (But the dolls melt away where they stand, stopped by Glaucos’s magical barrier.)
strings.%s…, 신에게 사랑받는 심부름꾼이여. 이제 내가 준비한 극은 끝을 향해: %s... Messenger beloved by a god. The play I prepared has reached its end. I ask only that you bring it to a close.
Breaking Circe’s curse—that is the story of the final act.
strings.날 죽이게. 그러면 섬의 주인인 내 힘이 모두 깃든 이 공간이 키르케를: Kill me. Then this space, imbued with all my power as the island’s master, will imprison Circe forever.
If that happens, you and the others can return home safely.
strings.그렇지 않으면 …. 윽, 으으으윽, 키르케, 그만 하거라!! 키…, 르케: Otherwise... Ngh, aaaagh! Circe, stop!! Cir... ce...
strings.(이야기를 이어가던 글라우코스의 눈에서 초점이 사라진다. 그리고 누군가를: (Glaucos’s eyes lose their focus mid-sentence. Like a puppet speaking for someone else, he begins using a different voice.)
strings.%s, 나는 네가 신의 심부름꾼이든 뭐든 누구라도 상관없어. 어차피 넌: %s, I do not care whether you are a god’s messenger or anyone else. You have become a nuisance to me either way.
strings.이제 내가 어떻게 할지는 알고 있겠지?: You know what I am going to do now, do you not?
I do not want to know.
strings.짜증 나…. 짜증 나. 너 짜증 난다고!: Annoying... So annoying. You are so annoying!
strings.(글라우코스의 의식을 잠식한 누군가는 대답이 만족스럽지 않았는지 담고 있: (The one who has taken over Glaucos’s mind seems displeased by the answer, repeating the same seething words over and over.)
strings.(그것도 잠시 뿐, 인형의 주인은 언제나 그랬던 것처럼 인형이 될 대상에: (But only for a moment. As always, the dolls’ owner simply announces what awaits the next person to become a doll.)
strings.알려줄게, 이대로 얌전히 인형극의 단원이 되는 거야! 스킬라와 글라우코스: Let me tell you! You will quietly join my puppet troupe, just as Scylla and Glaucos did!!
strings.(힘겹게 전투를 이어가던 %s의 시야에 조명빛을 받아 반짝거리는 뭔가가: (As %s struggles through the fight, something glints in the stage lights.)
(Seizing an opening, the adventurer cuts every thread binding Glaucos. His strength spent, the island’s master collapses.)
strings.(글라우코스가 힘겨운 목소리를 내며 겨우 일어나 앉는다.): (With a strained groan, Glaucos barely manages to sit up.)
strings.안심해도 되네. 이제 키르케는 나에게 영향을 줄 수 없으니까. 내가 정신: You may rest easy. Circe can no longer affect me. If I have regained my senses, her threads must all be gone.
If you cannot trust me, you may kill me here and now.
strings.(체념하는 것 같은 글라우코스의 표정에 알 수 없는 쓸쓸함이 묻어난다.): (An unfathomable loneliness shows through Glaucos’s resigned expression.)
strings.그대 덕분에 난 삶을 이어가게 됐지만, 키르케를 멈출 순 없게 됐어. 아: Thanks to you, I will live on, but now I can no longer stop Circe. Ah, I do not blame you.
If this is the fate of us all, then so be it.
strings.(멀리서 키르케의 목소리와 함께 바늘과 실이 날아오지만, 여전히 유지되고: (Needles and thread fly in from afar with Circe’s voice, but the magical barrier still holds them back.)
strings.저 아이의 말은 신경 쓰지 말게. 지금 이 순간, 이 무대는 온전히 나의: Pay no heed to her. At this moment, this stage is wholly mine, beyond the reach of even a witch’s tricks.
strings.이제 새로운 신의 심부름꾼인 그대에게 이야기하려 하네. 그래야 신께서도: Now I will speak to you, the new messenger of a god. Through you, the god will become aware of their existence.
Ask me what you wish to know...
strings.(…물어볼게 많아. 어느 것부터 물어볼까?): (...I have so many questions. Where should I begin?)
strings.1. 섬의 주인 글라우코스에 대해: 1. About Glaucos, master of the island
I am Glaucos, master of this island. I am the incarnation of an ancient god whose very name has been forgotten.
Do not look so surprised. You must already have met beings like me.
strings.그걸 어떻게 알고 계시죠? 아니다, 신의 현신이라면 이미 알고 계셔도 무: How do you know? No, if you are the incarnation of a god, I suppose that is hardly surprising...
I too once walked among them... It is only natural that I sense changes in the world. Though I was an incarnation, the god wished me to love this place and live here.
strings.그렇게 의지를 선물해주셨고, 멀리 원래 있던 곳으로 돌아가셨지. 나는 그: The god granted me a will of my own, then returned to that distant place of origin. I have remained here ever since.
strings.아름다운 섬은 대륙을 찾는 많은 손님으로 항상 붐볐네. 살아있다는 게 이: This beautiful island was always bustling with visitors to the continent. Thinking this must be what it meant to be alive, I prepared many things for them.
strings.신들과 뒤틀린 자의 분쟁이 시작되고, 대륙이 반으로 갈라져 하늘로 떠오르: Then the conflict between the gods and the Twisted One began. The continent split in two and rose into the sky, and Aie Island was hidden from sight.
strings.더는 섬엔 손님이 오질 않았지만, 언젠가 찾아올 이들을 위해 극본을 쓰고: Visitors no longer came, but I kept writing plays for those who might arrive someday. This stage, this theater—all of it was for gods and living beings...
strings.(글라우코스가 마력의 결계로 가득 채워져 있는 무대를 둘러본다.): (Glaucos surveys the stage, filled with his magical barrier.)
That was what this stage was meant to be. And now I have made such a ruin of it...
strings.스킬라도 이곳의 주민이었나요?: Was Scylla a resident here too?
strings.스킬라는 프레이오스 대륙에 나타난 악마를 잡던 용사이자 기사였네. 기구를: Scylla was a hero and a knight who hunted the demons appearing in Freios. While traveling by balloon, she was caught in a magical vortex and fell onto the island.
strings.발견됐을 때, 그녀는 충격으로 정신을 잃어 깨어나지 못했어. 나는 그녀가: When we found her, the shock had left her unconscious, and she would not wake. I cared for her for a long time, hoping she would open her eyes.
strings.오랜 시간이 흘러 깨어났지만, 세계의 시간은 많이 바뀌었고…. 그녀는 실: She finally awoke after many years, but the world had changed greatly... She could not help being dismayed.
strings.그래도 스킬라는 금방 일어나 이 섬에 적응했네. 내 극본을 보면서 즐거워: Still, Scylla soon found her feet and adapted to the island. She enjoyed my plays and understood them. We spent a long time sharing our feelings through those stories.
strings.벌써 그 시간도 오래됐군. 마력의 영향으로 스킬라도 육체의 시간이 멈춰버: Even that was long ago now. Magic stopped her body from aging, so time has lost its meaning...
But we were happy in those days. Then Circe appeared...
strings.나는 스킬라도, 이 섬도 제대로 지키지도 못했고, 인형의 저주도 이겨내지: I failed to protect Scylla or this island. I could not overcome the doll’s curse, either.
That is not true. You held on and came back to yourself.
Yes. That is why I have survived to speak with you, even like this...
strings.스킬라와 섬을 산책 중에 어디선가 강한 마력이 느껴졌었다…. 우리는 서둘: Scylla and I were walking around the island when we felt powerful magic somewhere... We hurried toward it.
strings.그곳엔 한 소녀가 쓰러져 있었지. 그래도 일으켜 세우니까 금방 정신을 차: A young girl lay unconscious there. When we helped her up, she quickly came to her senses.
strings.주위를 둘러보고는 환하게 웃는데, 크게 문제는 없어보였어. 그렇게 그 아: She looked around and smiled brightly. Nothing seemed seriously wrong. She stayed with us for a while.
strings.키르케라는 이름 말고는 아무것도 알려주지 않았지만, 우리는 괜찮았네. 우: She told us nothing but her name, Circe, and that was fine with us. We only wanted to help her recover so she could go home.
strings.그동안 그 아이가 나타났을 때 느꼈던 강한 마력에 대해선 잊었지만…. 그: In the meantime, we forgot the powerful magic we had sensed at her arrival... Little did we know how dearly that would cost us...
strings.오직 자신만의 친구가 되어달라면서 우리 사이를 질투했지. 어떤 감정인지는: She demanded we be her friends alone and grew jealous of our bond. I could not understand exactly what she felt, but she seemed deeply unsettled.
strings.그래서 우리는 키르케를 돌려보내려고 했어. 여기는 키르케가 있기에 좋은: So we tried to send her home. We thought this was not a good place for her to stay.
strings.하지만, 키르케는 계속해서 돌아왔고, 우리를 향한 집착도 심해졌어. 그러: But Circe kept returning, and her obsession with us deepened. Then, by chance, we witnessed her power.
I had thought she was hiding something... But never imagined a power like that...
strings.키르케가 숨기고 있던 능력은 손 안에서 원하는 모든 걸 인형으로 만드는: The power she concealed could turn anything she wished into a doll in her hands...
strings.스킬라는 그게 마계에서 흘러 들어온 능력이란 걸 깨닫고 키르케를 설득하려: Scylla realized it was a power that had seeped in from the Demon Realm and tried to reason with her. But it was already too late.
Parts of Scylla’s body had already become a doll, and Circe controlled her. I tried to face Circe too, but even I, an incarnation, was powerless...
strings.나는 그녀를 지키기 위해서 키르케에게 부탁했지. 이런 짓을 하지 말아달라: To protect Scylla, I pleaded with Circe. I begged her to stop, but she would not. Instead, she said...
strings.글라우코스, 스킬라가 받을 나머지 저주를 모두 받으라고…. 왜 자신을 마: Glaucos, take all the rest of Scylla’s curse... She asked why we saw her only as a witch...
strings.이야기는 이쯤 해야겠네. 이 정도면 신께서 이 상황을 받아들일 수 있을: That is enough for now. This should let the god grasp the situation. Circe has gone...
strings.(마력의 결계 밖에 서있던 키르케의 모습이 사라져 보이지 않는다.): (Circe, who stood outside the magical barrier, is no longer anywhere to be seen.)
With her power no longer working here, she has no reason to stay.
strings.혹시 이곳에 찾아온 사람들이 더 있나?: Has anyone else come to this island?
Two people. One was stranded here, and one came with me.
strings.그러면 그대는 이걸 가지고 서둘러 헤이든에게 가게. 그러면 더는 키르케가: Then take this and hurry to Hayden. Once you do, Circe will no longer be able to affect this island.
strings.그럴게요. 그런데, 이게 뭐죠?: I will. But what is it?
strings.아이에 섬의 근간이 되는 정기일세. 혹시 몰라 미리 내가 챙겨뒀지. 자,: The essence that forms the foundation of Aie Island. I set it aside beforehand, just in case. Now, adventurer beloved by a god... Take it to Hayden, the island’s spirit.
strings.(헤이든도 원래는 인형의 정령이 아니었구나.): (So Hayden was not originally a doll spirit, either.)
I will take it to her right away.
strings.고생했네. 나는 스킬라를 찾으러 갈 테니, 부디 조심해서 돌아가게…. 헤: You have done well. I will find Scylla, so take care on your way back... I will visit Hayden later...
All right. You take care too. Time for me to go...
strings.(그렇게 극장 밖으로 나가려는 %s의 앞에 한 소녀가 나타난다. 극장에: (As %s moves to leave the theater, a girl appears—the same girl the dolls abducted when you first entered.)
Oh, are you... all right? Those dolls carried you away earlier.
strings.정신차려 보니 괜찮아, 열쇠. 아, 미안. 혼자 부르는 말이 입에 붙어서: I am all right now that I have come to my senses, key. Oh, sorry. I got used to calling you that to myself...
strings.고마워. 인형이 되지 않게 해줘서…. 내가 인형이 됐다면 이 세계의 모든: Thank you for keeping me from becoming a doll... If I had, everything in this world might have ended...
I do not know what you mean, but there is no need to thank me. Come on, let us get out of here. The way is...
No. I cannot go with you.
Because we cannot be together. Instead... I will tell you my name.
My name is Hilda. You need not remember it. We will not meet again. I will never appear before you again, either.
strings.(자신을 힐다라고 소개한 소녀 앞으로 서서히 그림자가 피어오른다. 잠시: (Shadows slowly rise before the girl who called herself Hilda. A moment later, she has vanished without a trace.)
Where did she go? After saying all those things I do not understand...
I will think about it later. First, Hayden.
I am fine, but you lost consciousness as soon as you saw me, %s.
I did? But I came over and handed you the item...
strings.너무 많은 일들이 이곳에서 벌어져서 그래요. %s 님 덕분에 저는 인형의: So much has happened here. Thanks to you, %s, I am completely free of the puppet strings.
strings.다행이에요. 그런데 헤이든은 인형의 정령이 아니었던 거죠?: I am glad. But you were never really a doll spirit, were you?
strings.…저는 섬의 정령…. 아이에에 속한 모든 것을 글라우코스 님과 함께 돌보: ...I am the spirit of the island. Together with Glaucos, I care for everything that belongs to Aie.
The dolls were here too, so calling me a doll spirit was not entirely wrong.
strings.(헤이든의 표정처럼 안고 있는 인형의 표정도 왠지 즐거워 보인다.): (The doll in her arms somehow looks as happy as Hayden herself.)
strings.헤이든, 제가 정신을 잃었던 시간이 얼마나 지난 거죠? 기분이 살짝 이상: Hayden, how long was I unconscious? I feel a little strange...
Yes... I imagine a witch’s power had something to do with it.
strings.그러면 여기 저와 함께 있었던 다른 사람들은 어떻게 됐죠?: Then what happened to the others who were here with me?
strings.뒤틀린 어둠을 쓰는 기사께서 절 알아보셔서 설명 드렸어요. 알았다고 하시: The knight who wields twisted darkness recognized me, so I explained. She said she understood and helped put things in order here with the woman in glasses.
strings.그 전에 키르케의 저주로 인형이 됐던 사람들이 원래 모습으로 돌아왔거든요: By then, the people Circe had turned into dolls had regained their original forms. The two of them escorted everyone off the island.
strings.그건 다행인데…, 인형이 됐던 사람들은 괜찮은 건가요?: That is a relief... Are the people who became dolls all right?
strings.체력적으로 문제가 있긴 한데, 그건 안정을 취하면 될거같아요. 그리고 인: They are physically weakened, but rest should take care of that. They do not remember being dolls. Please do not worry too much...
strings.스킬라 님과 글라우코스 님도 안정을 취하고 계세요. 지금은 아니지만, 나: Scylla and Glaucos are resting too. They would like you to visit again later, once they have recovered.
...I am glad they are all right.
strings.저도 이렇게 여신님의 사람을 만날 수 있어서 좋았어요. 때가 되면 저도: I am glad I could meet someone who serves the goddess. When the time comes, I will go and see Lady Iris too.
strings.(헤이든이 계속해서 뭔가 말하고 있지만, %s에게 아무것도 들리지 않는다: (Hayden continues speaking, but %s cannot hear a thing.)
Hayden, what was that? Could you say it again? I cannot hear you...
strings.(갑자기 시야에서 헤이든의 모습이 흔적도 없이 사라진다. 대신, 그 자리: (Hayden suddenly vanishes from sight. In her place stands the witch Circe, making no effort to hide her ominous power.)
strings.(서둘러 키르케에게 다가가지만, 어떤 장벽에 의해 가로막힌다.): (You rush toward Circe, only to be stopped by a barrier.)
strings.그렇게 소리 질러도 넌 지금 이 공간에선 아무 것도 못해. 물론, 나도: Shout all you like. You cannot do anything in this space. Of course, neither can I...
How dare you undo the blessing on my friends. I really do not like you...
strings.무슨 이야기를 하고 싶은 거야? 그게 축복이라고?: What are you trying to say? You call that a blessing?
Yes, a blessing. And you ruined it all.
strings.여긴 내가 사랑받아야 하는 장소야. 나를 사랑하고 내가 사랑하는 인형들이: This is where I am supposed to be loved. Where the dolls who love me, and whom I love, belong!!
strings.그런데 네가 뭔데 날 망치려 들어?: Who do you think you are, trying to ruin everything?
strings.…널 도와준 사람들을 인형으로 만든 게 사랑받고 싶어 한 짓이야?: ...You turned the people who helped you into dolls because you wanted to be loved?
I needed friends to play with. I only wanted a family who would love me...
strings.이런 날 위해 신께서 소원을 들어주신 것밖에 없어. 주위에 친구 하나 없: A god simply granted my wish. I had no friends, so the god gave me the power to make them!
strings.그런데 왜? 왜 날 사랑하지 않아? 왜 사랑하지 않는 거야?: So why? Why do they not love me? Why will they not love me?
Instead, they all tried to kill me, saying I was cursed. What did I ever do...? What is wrong with my power...?
strings.그러다 이곳에 오게 됐는데, 내게 손을 내밀어주는 사람이 있는 거야, 후: Then I came here, and there were people who reached out to me. Hehe.
Scylla and Glaucos were good friends. ☆ I like Glaucos so much.
I would suit Glaucos better than Scylla, but he turned me down. Hmph. What is wrong with me? Well, bye-bye, Glaucos and Scylla. ☆
strings.그런데 걔네들보다 더 좋은 친구가 있더라. 그래서 같이 놀다가 인형으로: Then I found an even better friend. We were playing, and I was going to make her into a doll, but you spoiled that too.
strings.흥, 맘에 안들어!: Hmph. I do not like you!
strings.응, 맞아. 너도 봤구나. 여기로 숨으려고 오다니 마녀치고 너무 허술하단: Yes, her. You saw her too. Coming here to hide—awfully careless for a witch.
strings.(…힐다…라고 했었는데, 마녀였구나….): (...She said her name was Hilda. So she was a witch...)
strings.그래서 넌 왜 그 소녀를 인형으로 만들려고 했어?: Then why were you trying to turn her into a doll?
strings.웅, 그야 마녀니까☆: Well, because she is a witch. ☆
strings.사람들이 말하는 마녀니까 그렇게 해야 하는 거 아니었어?: She is one of those witches people talk about. Is that not what I am supposed to do?
strings.(키르케가 전혀 모르겠다는 표정으로 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Circe stares at %s with an expression of complete incomprehension.)
strings.판도라가 루세리아를 그렇게 만든 것처럼 나도 그렇게 만들어야 해. 안 그: Just as Pandora did that to Luceria, I have to do the same. Otherwise, I will die too. ☆
I have told you my story. Now I will listen to yours.
Go on. I will hear you out.
strings.듣고 싶다니까 이야기해줄게. 넌 어떤 게 사랑인지 동정인지 호감인지 판단: Since you want to hear it, I will tell you. You are a fool who cannot even tell love from pity or affection.
strings.네가 한 짓을 봐. 사랑받기 위해서 잘한 일이라 생각해? 네 능력이 다른: Look at what you have done. Do you think this was the right way to make people love you? Your power became a curse the moment it caused others pain.
strings.어차피 넌 죽을 거야!! 누가 죽이기 전에 내가 널 인형으로 만들 거니까: You are going to die anyway!! I will turn you into a doll before anyone can kill you!!
strings.그래야 널 아끼는 여신조차 네 존재를 잊어버리지!!: Then even the goddess who cherishes you will forget you ever existed!!
strings.인형이 된 널 마수의 장난감으로 던져 줄 거야!! 솜뭉치가 터져 나온 인: I will throw you to the demonic beasts as a toy!! You will be nothing but a doll with its stuffing spilling out. Just you wait!!
strings.(분한 것 같던 키르케에게서 광기 어린 웃음이 터져나온다. 잠시 후, 두: (Circe’s frustration bursts into crazed laughter. A moment later, the space around them begins to shake.)
strings.…그러면 넌 너의 세계로 돌아가. 나는 나의 세계로 갈게. 다신 만나고: ...Go back to your world, then. I will go to mine. I never want to see you again, but you are already bound to the witches...
Like it or not, we will meet again. Walpurgis Night will draw you to us.
strings.그러면 안녕, 다음엔 꼭 내 인형이 되어줄 친구야☆: Goodbye, then, my friend who will surely become my doll next time. ☆
strings.(키르케가 있던 공간이 사라지고 다시 헤이든의 모습이 시야에 들어온다.): (The space where Circe stood disappears, and Hayden comes back into view.)
I feel a little dizzy... Ugh. Circe was here...
A witch, indeed... She appeared with her presence concealed.
It seemed like the Other Side.
An Other Side that even a spirit could not properly perceive...
strings.보통 이면은 특정 공간에서 나타나지만, 키르케가 있었던 곳은 시간의 흐름: Normally, the Other Side appears within a particular space. But the place Circe occupied seems to have been created by twisting the flow of time.
...Her will, mingled with some other power...
Enough to control even an incarnation like Glaucos and a spirit like me...
strings.뒤에 누가 있는지 알 수 없지만, 마녀는 그런 존재예요. 마음만 먹으면: I do not know who stands behind her, but that is what a witch is: a being capable of anything she sets her mind to...
strings.(현신조차 마음대로 해버린다면….): (If she can control even an incarnation...)
I will talk to Iris about this later.
strings.네, 그렇게 하시는 게 좋을 거 같아요. 그런데, 지금은 괜찮으세요?: Yes, that would be best. But are you all right now?
I was a little dizzy, but I am fine now. I should get going.
strings.네, %s 님. 가시는 길에 기사님께 고마웠다고 전해주시겠어요?: Of course, %s. Could you thank the knight for me on your way?
I will, Hayden. I will come and visit again.
We were worried when you did not return.
strings.(리코타가 조용히 하라는 시늉과 함께 %s의 손을 잡아끈다.): (Licota motions for silence and takes %s by the hand.)
%s, there is no need to tell Yeonhee the details.
strings.제가 들으면 안 되는 이야기라도 있나요?: Is it something I should not hear?
strings.…네, 영업 비밀 같은 거라서요. 연희 님께서 쓰시는 기행문에 악영향을: ...Yes. Something like a trade secret. It could also have an unfortunate effect on your travel writing...
Aha. Then it cannot be helped. I will keep quiet about the dolls.
strings.저는 표류된 거예요. 그래서 여러분들이 저를 포함해서 섬에 표류한 분들을: I was stranded. You brought me and the other people stranded on the island safely back. That is all.
strings.(연희가 환하게 웃으며 다이어리를 들어 보인다.): (Yeonhee smiles brightly and holds up her journal.)
strings.덕분에 아이에 섬에서의 기억이 좋은 경험이 됐습니다. 기록으로도 남길 수: Thanks to you, my time on Aie Island became a worthwhile experience. I am glad I can leave a record of it too.
strings.(일단은 저렇게 해준다니 믿는 수밖에.): (For now, I can only trust her to do as she says.)
strings.(연희가 안경을 닦다가 다시 한 번 %s의 눈을 바라본다.): (While cleaning her glasses, Yeonhee looks into %s’s eyes once more.)
Was there something you wanted to say...?
Sorry. I cannot see very well right now, so I was squinting. Do not mind me.
strings.아, 그러셨군요. 가시는 길이라면 게이트까지 바래다 드릴까요?: Oh, I see. If you are leaving, shall I walk you to the gate?
strings.아니에요. 괜찮아요. 안 그래도 마중 나오실 분이 있으세요. 제가 올 때: No, that is all right. Someone has come to meet me. When I did not arrive at the expected time, they came here themselves.
We will meet again, %s. You too, Rico.
strings.(연희가 환한 미소와 함께 손을 흔들며 게이트웨이로 향한다.): (Yeonhee waves with a bright smile and heads toward the gateway.)
strings.일단은 믿어볼까요?: Shall we give her the benefit of the doubt?
Trust can be surprisingly fragile, like glass... But yes. Let us trust her.
strings.그러면 저는 제 일을 하러 가볼게요. 당분간 여기에 있을 테니까 제 도움: I will get back to my work, then. I will be here for a while, so come find me if you need help.
strings.(리코타가 고개를 끄덕이고 네레이스 관문의 사무실이 있는 곳으로 발걸음을: (Licota nods and walks toward the Nereis Gateway offices.)
strings.(키르케가 어디로 갔는지, 다른 마녀들이 뭘 하는지도 모르는데…. 그냥: (I do not know where Circe went or what the other witches are doing... Should I just wait...?)
My apologies. I nearly bumped into you.
No, I was not looking where I was going.
(Looking at the person you almost bumped into, you get the feeling you have met somewhere before.)
strings.(이 사람, 어디서 봤었지? 낯익은 느낌이네….): (Where have I seen him? He feels familiar...)
strings.(굳은 표정과 깊은 얼굴의 상처, 귀족 느낌이 가득한 제복 차림의 중년: (A middle-aged man with a stern face, a deep facial scar, and an unmistakably aristocratic uniform regards the adventurer warmly.)
I did not expect to meet you here.
strings.활약상은 많이 들었습니다, %s…. 아, 제 소개가 늦었군요. 저는 아론: I have heard much of your exploits, %s... Ah, I should have introduced myself. My name is Aaron. I hold a modest post in the Silvaria Imperial Council.
strings.그동안 제국의 일을 도와주셔서 감사드립니다. 어쩌면 나중에 계속해서 만날: Thank you for all you have done for the Empire. Perhaps we will be seeing more of each other. There is the matter of the witches, after all.
Ah, my guest is waiting. I must go. A pleasure to meet you.
strings.(아론이라고 자신을 소개한 중년 남자가 할 말만 하고 서둘러 게이트가 있: (The middle-aged man who introduced himself as Aaron says his piece and hurries toward the gates.)
strings.뭐지, 저 사람? 저 사람도 마녀를 알고 있는 건가? 높은 사람이라 마녀: What was that about? Does he know about the witches too? Is it because he is a high-ranking official?
strings.황제와 관련된 사람인 것 같긴 한데…. 나중에 데이나 씨나 이리스에게 물: He does seem to be connected to the emperor... I will ask Dayna or Iris later.
strings.(한편, 모험가가 자리를 떠나자 멀리서 이곳을 바라보고 있던 아론이 천천: (Meanwhile, once the adventurer leaves, Aaron, who has been watching from a distance, slowly emerges.)
strings.저렇게 훌륭한 힘인데, 그때 가져가지 못했다니…. 이미 지난 일인데 어쩔: Such magnificent power, and I failed to take it back then... What is done is done, I suppose.
strings.앞으로 마녀들을 불러내기에 훌륭한 미끼가 될 테니, 열심히 지원해야겠어…: It will make excellent bait for drawing out the witches. I should give it all the support I can...
